entities.name: The Chimes
entities.description: Magical valley behind mount Sarraza in the Borderlands, home of elves and giant standing chimes.

entities.name: Mount Sarraza
entities.description: Mountain beneath which the Beast of the Hours was bound.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: Great cockatrice bound beneath mount Sarraza and later banished.

entities.name: Samor the Collector
entities.description: Songmage who discovered the chimes' use in song-magic and made a banishing song spell.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: Songmage who used the spell to banish the Beast of the Hours.

entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: Island group containing Almaaz and the Chimes.

events.summary: In 35 AR, after binding the Beast of the Hours, Samor discovers the Chimes and creates a banishing song spell at the cost of the chimes' integrity.
events.quote: He created a song spell that would banish the bound beast should it ever be released

events.summary: Over 3000 years later Ogwater Rifkin uses the spell to release and banish the Beast; the chimes break.
events.quote: Ogwater succeeded in his attempt, and the Beast of the Hours was no more.
